units.lexicalLiteral: one Lua string literal outside comments; a lead only, never counted as visible or translatable
units.record: one source span that produces one player-visible text unit (a label, a tooltip line, a status sentence, one composed row). A composed sentence is one record, with each runtime value as a {placeholder}; separate visible lines are separate records. Recorded at its ORIGIN file:line (which may be a traced core/ or shared ui/ file) under the family whose surface shows it.

reachability.reachable_branch: worker visibility conditional with a stated ordinary branch predicate (refusal, failure, fallback, state) and no qualifier listed below

procedure: Unit tooltip (ui/Nameplate.lua) and On-screen Wishlist (ui/WishlistOverlay.lua) were read in full and classified directly.

Wishlist editor, Build Library and Leaderboard were classified by five read-only workers with one shared written record schema (editor split at WishlistRenderer line 1100, library at CommunityRenderer line 2360), then merged.

Merge: 49 IDs recorded by both halves of a family (shared origin spans) were merged (states and dependencies unioned; four differed only in placeholder names); 7 records cited one line early or late were re-anchored to the line holding their bytes (ED-WC-0628-a, ED-WC-0657-a, ED-WC-1719-a, ED-GA-2634-a, ED-GA-3242-a, ED-GA-3248-a, LD-DC-3348-a); 3 records were corrected (ED-WC-2064-a lineEnd, ED-WR-3308-a an inlined variable restored as {again}, LB-CR-2555-a origin constant CR:12); decoded newlines were restored to the source escape form.

Byte verification: every record's literal fragments (text between {placeholders}, alternatives split on ' | ') were checked against the git blob at its cited lines: exact = contiguous in source; composed = covered only by joining literal pieces in the span (code-joined branches). spanCheck is stored per record.

Independent spot checks by the inventory author against source: LD:386-391, LD:1055-1058, SM:160-166, WE:156-159, WC:163-166, FU:8-25, LD:145-148, CC:1285-1288, CR:2450-2533, CR:2092-2108, CR:2612-2643, CP:440-458, WR:836-1010, WR:1684-1698, NP:1-170, WO:1-522, DpsCapture:3581-3600 and its migrations, SyncSession:224-240.

Classification of visibility, states, coupling and dependencies beyond those spot checks is worker-produced and byte-verified, not individually re-derived. Treat per-record semantics as reviewable evidence, not acceptance.

Review correction (SPEC144-01..04, S144-1/2, N144-1/2): reachability added per record without changing any record ID, English, span, class or worker label; the 54 audited qualification notes were re-triaged against source together with every other qualifying note found by a note scan (122 records matched; 35 verified not_displayed, 54 unknown, the other 33 are stated branches or non-qualifying wording and stay reachable/reachable_branch). The unknown count of 54 is coincidental: it is not the reviewer's 54-record set (see reviewCorrections.qualificationCrossTab). State indexes, totals and candidate subcounts are now derived only from record fields.
method.lexicalScanner: Python, deterministic: walk the blob; skip '--' comments (including long-bracket comments); a short string starts at an unescaped quote and ends at the matching quote, a backslash consumes the next character; a long string is [[...]] or [=*[...]=*]. literalsWithSpaceAndWord = literal containing a space and two consecutive ASCII letters. Run on `git cat-file -p HEAD:<path>` bytes.
method.idRule: ID = <family>-<file>-<anchor line>-<ordinal>; the anchor line lies within [line, lineEnd] and equals line except ED-WR-3132-a (documented interior anchor of the composed span 3130-3133)

lexicalLead.unit: Lua 5.1 string literal outside comments (short and long-bracket forms), counted on git blob bytes at the inventory HEAD

records.english: This saves its current title, description and Echo list as an update of your shared listing on this client, then queues a short summary for other Nexus users if your saved Sync mode and its size allow. The summary has no Echo list or description; the full listing can be sent in answers to other Nexus users' requests, and an answer on the shared Sync channel may be kept by any Nexus user who receives it. It is listed with your character name, realm and class. In Automatic, if your character's best Training Dummy or Lich King DPS is linked to this listing, Nexus may also send each such DPS record with its Echoes, any locked Echoes and your player info (character name, realm, class, level) without an additional request, even if the summary is not queued. A shared build cannot be recalled: players who receive it keep their copy, and Stop Sharing removes only the listing on this client. Nexus cannot confirm who received it.{offSentence}
